## Description

Configure PITR retention (35 days in prod), long-term retention per country rule, backups kept in-country; storage soft delete/versioning for Blob. Write runbook docs/runbooks/restore.md and perform one restore of staging to a new database, verifying data and timing.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** PITR and LTR settings are defined in Bicep, not set by hand.
- [ ] **AC2.** A restore drill of staging completes and the elapsed time is recorded in the runbook (P0 exit gate 2).
- [ ] **AC3.** Restored database passes a smoke test (row counts per table match the point in time).
- [ ] **AC4.** Backup storage redundancy keeps data in-country (no geo-replication outside the country).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
